rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Changing remembrance on the tongue causes God to replace the heart’s spiritual inclinations with forgetfulness and heedlessness.
rows.anchor: إذا غيروا ما بألسنتهم من الذكر غير الله ما بقلوبهم من الحظوظ فأبدلهم به النسيان والغفلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God changes a servant’s inward state when the servant abandons proper manners, violates a right, or commits a sin.
rows.anchor: فالله لا يغير ما بأنفسهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God does not withdraw outward or inward blessings until a person leaves gratitude and praise.
rows.anchor: لا يكف ما أتاحه للعبد من النعمة الظاهرة أو الباطنة حتى يترك ويغير ما هو به من الشكر والحمد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ingratitude, heedlessness, and disobedience cause blessing to be replaced by deprivation and abandonment, and beneficence to be withdrawn.
rows.anchor: وسلبه ما كان يعطيه من الإحسان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A servant seeking release from repeated trials must change his own state; beginning to plead after silence and show distress after calm changes his patience.
rows.anchor: فلا يصل إليه النفض منها إلا بأن يغير ما هو به ؛ فيأخذ في السؤال بعد السكوت ، وفي إظهار الجزع بعد السكون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whatever God wills as a trial necessarily comes to pass.
rows.anchor: ما تعلقت به المشيئة لا محالة يجري

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When God wills harm for people, He lets them choose what brings their ruin, so they walk toward destruction themselves.
rows.anchor: حتى يعملوا ويختاروا ما فيه بلاؤهم

rows.speaker: قائلهم
rows.claim: A poet depicts people as walking toward their own death: their feet bring about their bloodshed.
rows.anchor: قال قائلهم : إلى حتفي مشى قدمي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Outwardly, lightning brings fear that rain will be withheld and hope that it will arrive; travelers may fear its harm while residents hope for its benefit.
rows.anchor: خوف من إحباس المطر وطمع في مجيئه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Inward lightning is a sequence of signs, then flashes, then pure brightness: the lights of presence followed by the lights of unveiling.
rows.anchor: بما يبدو فيها من اللوائح ثم اللوامع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The seeker fears these lights will cease and hopes they will endure, progressing from presence to unveiling, witnessing, existence, abiding, and finally complete extinction.
rows.anchor: فيه نقل صاحبه من المحاضرة إلى المكاشفة ، ثم من المكاشفة إلى المشاهدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lightning can signify proof, then the moons of elucidation, then the daylight of gnosis; the suns of divine unity never disappear.
rows.anchor: ثم يزيد فيصير كأقمار البيان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The lights of union make the mystics fear nights of separation, since joy in union is often followed by a wave of parting.
rows.anchor: تبدو لهم أنوار الوصال فيخافون أن تجن عليهم ليالي الفرقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some believers find solace and purity through their own remembrance of God.
rows.anchor: قوم اطمأنت قلوبهم بذكرهم الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Other hearts find rest through remembrance because God remembers those servants graciously and specially instills tranquility in them.
rows.anchor: وقوم اطمأنت قلوبهم بذكر الله فذكرهم الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Remembering that God remembers them brings relief to their hearts, joy to their spirits, and ease to their inner selves.
rows.anchor: إذا ذكروا أن الله ذكرهم استروحت قلوبهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A heart that does not find rest in God’s remembrance has an inward defect and is not among sound hearts.
rows.anchor: إذا كان العبد لا يطمئن قلبه بذكر الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The believers’ times and souls are blessed; they have blessedness in their present state and a good return in the end.
rows.anchor: طابت أوقاتهم وطابت نفوسهم . ويقال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad’s mission among a new nation follows many earlier messengers; if his people harm him, earlier prophets suffered likewise, so patience brings their reward.
rows.anchor: لئن أرسلناك بالنبوة إليهم فلقد أرسلنا قبلك كثيرا من الرسل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If they disbelieve in the Merciful, the Prophet should believe and not worry about deniers.
rows.anchor: لئن كفروا بنا فآمن أنت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet is the purpose singled out from creation, specially chosen for the message and divine love.
rows.anchor: فإنك أنت المقصود من البرية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If actions or creation could have a purpose, Muhammad would be its central purpose and master of humanity; a poem illustrates one created person addressing another as his beloved goal.
rows.anchor: لو كان الغرض في الخلقة فأنت سيد البشر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Only God originates creation; good and evil and the whole affair belong to Him, so no created thing can independently bring about change, even through the Qur’an.
rows.anchor: والخير والشر جملة من الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase “Have the believers not despaired?” can mean “Have they not known?”
rows.anchor: معناه أفلم يعلم الذين آمنوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, believers have given up hope of bringing people to faith, knowing that only one whom God guides is truly guided.
rows.anchor: ويقال أفلم ييأسوا من إيمانهم وقد علموا أنه من يهديه الحق فهو المهتدي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “This is a straight path upon Me” is a threat, like saying, “Do as you wish; this is my way.”
rows.anchor: كما تقول : افعل ما شئت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Authority” means proof: proof belongs to God over creation, while the enemy has no proof or real power to affect a creature beyond its appointed limit.
rows.anchor: إذ لا تتعدى مقدرته محله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When God calls someone a servant, that person is among the elect; when He adds the servant to Himself, that person is the elect of the elect.
rows.anchor: إذا سمى الله واحدا عبدا فهو من جملة الخواص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s elect are erased from self-witness, protected from division, stripped of self-reliance, and kept within the manners of the sacred law while absorbed in witnessing God.
rows.anchor: وحفظهم وصانهم عن أسباب التفرقة وجردهم عن حولهم وقوتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because God preserves these servants and directs their states, the devil and the enemy have no path or hand over them.
rows.anchor: وكان النائب عنهم في جميع تصرفاتهم وحالاتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whoever witnesses divine unity and sees the world governed by decree is not prey to other forces; a poem calls denial of God’s rivals sanctification and reason in God confusion.
rows.anchor: ورأى العالم مصرفا في قبضة التقدير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People may share an origin in misguidance yet belong to different religions, and they will be gathered in punishment in distinct groups and levels.
rows.anchor: ثم يجتمعون غدا في العقوبة وهم زمر مختلفون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The truly Godfearing person is one whom God protects by grace; even self-discipline follows that prior protection.
rows.anchor: المتقي من وقاه الله بفضله لا من اتقى بتكلفه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Paradise has ranks in the afterlife, just as people already experience differing spiritual gardens and ranks in this life.
rows.anchor: هم اليوم في جنات ولها درجات بعضها أرفع من بعض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Present spiritual ranks include the sweetness of service, ease, hope, desire, intimacy, and nearness; each group follows its own path.
rows.anchor: اليوم لقوم درجة حلاوة الخدمة وتوفيق الطاعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command “Enter it” leaves the speaker unnamed.
rows.anchor: وأجمل ذلك ولم يقل من الذي يقول لهم

rows.speaker: قوم
rows.claim: Some hold that an angel tells the people of paradise to enter.
rows.anchor: ويرى قوم أن الملك يقول لهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who arrive after a long, hard journey have a right to enter; they may need the invitation to understand that paradise is open to them.
rows.anchor: إذا وافوا الجنة وقد قطعوا المسافة البعيدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It is possible that entry does not occur at the angel’s command until God Himself says, “Enter it.”
rows.anchor: ويقال يحتمل أنهم لا يدخلونها بقول الملك حتى يقول الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A poet says that only God clothes people in blessing and grants them the world.
rows.anchor: كما قالوا : ولا ألبس النعمى وغيرك ملبس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “In safety” means they are secure from ever being removed from paradise.
rows.anchor: بمعنى السلامة ، وهي الأمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They also never leave the spiritual state they have attained: vision and its abundant states endure for them.
rows.anchor: ويقال كما لا يخرجون من الجنة لا يخرجون عما هم عليه من الحال

rows.speaker: قوم
rows.claim: Some say Lot offered his own daughters to the people to turn them away from their vile intention, but they ignored his counsel.
rows.anchor: وقال قوم : أراد بناته من صلبه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels reassured Lot that he need not fear them because they had been sent to punish the people.
rows.anchor: حين أخبروه بحقيقة أمرهم ، وأنهم إنما أرسلوا للعقوبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God swears by Muhammad’s life to honor him and distinguish him above all creation.
rows.anchor: اقسم بحياته تخصيصا له في شرفه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The oath is also explained by Muhammad having the noblest life of anyone in his time.
rows.anchor: ويقال أقسم بحياته لأنه لم يكن في وقته حياة أشرف من حياته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lot’s people passed a night in joy but woke to calamity: their homes were overturned and punishment left no trace.
rows.anchor: باتوا في حبور وسرور ، وأصبحوا في محنة وثبور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The destruction is a clear lesson and sign for anyone willing to reflect and see.
rows.anchor: إن في ذلك لعبرة لمن اعتبر

rows.speaker: في التفسير
rows.claim: The exegetical gloss for “those who discern” is “the people of spiritual insight.”
rows.anchor: جاء في التفسير ( المتفرسين )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Firasah is an inward perception that, when a proof appears, is not opposed by contrary evidence and draws from the heart what its possessor perceives.
rows.anchor: والفراسة خاطر يحصل من غير أن يعارضه ما يخالفه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The word is related to a lion’s prey because the person of insight masters what is hidden.
rows.anchor: مشتق من فريسة الأسد إذ لفريسته يقهر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God reveals to His friends matters hidden from other people.
rows.anchor: والحق - سبحانه - يطلع أولئاءه على ما خفي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Spiritual insight is not guaranteed in every matter or at every moment; its perception may be blocked even for prophets.
rows.anchor: وصاحب الفراسة لا يكون بشرط التفرس في جميع الأشياء وفي جميع الأوقات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: During the slander against Aisha, the Prophet told her that if she had done it, she should repent to God.
rows.anchor: كان يقول لعائشة - رضي الله عنها -

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham and Lot did not recognize that their visitors were messengers.
rows.anchor: وكإبراهيم ولوط - عليهما السلام - لم يعرفا الرسل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people of the Thicket were Shuayb’s people; they denied him, so God took vengeance on them.
rows.anchor: أصحاب الأيكة هم قوم شعيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Both” refers to Midian and the people of the Thicket, which lie beside a clear, established road.
rows.anchor: يعني مدين والأيكة . . .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people of al-Hijr were Thamud; they rejected their messengers and the signs, including Salih’s she-camel.
rows.anchor: وكذلك أخبر أن أصحاب الحجر - وهم ثمود -

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Thamud clung to the earth, mistook God’s long respite for safety, and built mountain homes believing they were secure from death and punishment.
rows.anchor: وكانوا مغترين بطول إمهال الله إياهم من تأخير العقوبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A poetic line says that even after repeated absence, return to God occurs through existence.
rows.anchor: فإن تك منه غيبة بعد غيبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Truthfulness is better than lying; the truthful do not lie outright or repeat the words of a contemptible liar, whose error brings humiliation and punishment.
rows.anchor: والصديق لا يكذب صريحا ، ولا يتداول أقوال كاذب مهين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God clarified lawful and unlawful to earlier people; each was treated according to conduct, bringing the obedient near and turning the disobedient away.
rows.anchor: بين أنه أوضح لمن تقدم الحلال والحرام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When people regret past wrongdoing and sincere remorse erases its traces, God shows mercy, accepts their repentance when they reform, and saves them when they supplicate.
rows.anchor: فتاب عليهم إذا أصلحوا ، ونجاهم إذا تضرعوا

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One interpretation says Abraham believed in God alone and thus stood in the place of a whole community.
rows.anchor: قيل آمن بالله وحده فقام مقام الأمة

rows.speaker: في التفسير
rows.claim: A tafsir gloss describes Abraham as a teacher of good for a community.
rows.anchor: كان معلما - للخير - لأمة

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Another interpretation says Abraham gathered commendable qualities that are scattered among a whole community.
rows.anchor: ويقال اجتمع فيه من الخصال المحمودة ما يكون في أمة متفرقا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When Abraham called a created thing “my Lord,” he was not focused on creatures as such but was absorbed in witnessing God through the cosmos.
rows.anchor: ولم ينظر إلى المخلوقات من حيث هي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God made Abraham equivalent to the whole community: his continuous fulfillment of God’s due sufficed in place of all others.
rows.anchor: ففي القيام بحق الله منك على الدوام غنية عن الجميع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Hanif” can mean upright in religion or wholly inclined toward the Real.
rows.anchor: أو المائل إلى الحق بالكلية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: True gratitude means seeing one’s inability to thank and recognizing that God created, enabled, supplied, and chose the grateful servant for Himself.
rows.anchor: ويرى شكره من الله عز وجل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being guided to a straight path means realizing one is God’s servant and that God has raised him to the station of the eminent.
rows.anchor: أي تحقق بأنه عبده ، وأنه رقاه إلى محل الأكابر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One reading of the good bestowed on Abraham in this world is that God’s favor continued without interruption.
rows.anchor: الحسنة التي آتاه الله هي دوام ما آتاه حتى لم تنقطع عنه

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Another gloss identifies the good bestowed on Abraham as intimate friendship.
rows.anchor: ويقال هي الخلة

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Another gloss identifies it as prophethood and messengership.
rows.anchor: ويقال هي النبوة والرسالة

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: A further reading says Abraham’s worldly good was being wholly for God, with nothing in him remaining for anyone else.
rows.anchor: ويقال آتيناه في الدنيا حسنة حتى كان لنا بالكلية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham’s way means being with the Real and effacing awareness of oneself; Muhammad followed him in obedience to God’s command.
rows.anchor: ملة إبراهيم } أي الكون بالحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad followed Abraham’s way through generosity, altruism, and fidelity, then surpassed all others in rank.
rows.anchor: أنت ملة إبراهيم - عليه السلام - الخلق والسخاء والإيثار والوفاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People differed about the Sabbath: some treated work on it as forbidden, others made it permissible in disobedience, and some say Friday was assigned but they insisted on Saturday.
rows.anchor: قوم حرموا العمل فيه وقوم حللوه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their inward error was to turn from the command toward desire and fail to observe it properly, making it a cause of disobedience.
rows.anchor: الإشارة من ذلك أنهم حادوا عن موجب الأمر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Calling to God’s path means urging people to obey Him and restraining them from disobedience.
rows.anchor: الدعاء إلى سبيل الله بحث الناس على طاعة الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Wisdom requires that a caller’s actions not contradict what the caller commands others to do.
rows.anchor: والدعاء بالحكمة ألا يخالف بالفعل ما يأمر به الناس بالنطق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Good admonition comes from knowledge and sound judgment and contains no harshness.
rows.anchor: والموعظة الحسنة ما يكون صادرا عن علم وصواب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Debate in the best manner” means using the strongest proof and clearest method.
rows.anchor: وجادلهم بالتى هى أحسن } : بالحجة الأقوى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Enjoining right requires practicing what one commands and avoiding what one forbids, as in the cited statement of Shuayb.
rows.anchor: فشرط الأمر بالمعروف استعمال ما تأمر به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Retaliation for oppression must stay within the limit permitted by sacred law.
rows.anchor: فلا تتجاوزوا حد الإذن بما هو في حكم الشرع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Leaving retaliation for the sake of God is better for the patient.
rows.anchor: فتركتم الانتصاف لأجل مولاكم فهو خير لكم إن فعلتم ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some forgo retaliation hoping for a greater reward in the hereafter.
rows.anchor: فمنهم من يترك ذلك طمعا في الثواب غدا فإنه أوفر وأكثر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some forgo retaliation hoping God will take care of their opponents.
rows.anchor: ومنهم من يترك ذلك طمعا في أن يتكفل الله بخصومه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some forgo retaliation because they are content that God knows what is being done to them.
rows.anchor: ومنهم من يترك ذلك لأنه مكتف بعلم الله تعالى بما يجري عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some forgo retaliation out of nobility, freedom from danger, and a preference for forgiving when victorious.
rows.anchor: وتحرره عن الأخطار ولاستحبابه العفو عند الظفر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some deny having any right to themselves or others, making their property and blood freely expendable.
rows.anchor: ولا يعتقد أن لأحد هذا الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some see an opponent’s harm as recompense for their own disobedience, so they seek forgiveness for themselves instead of taking revenge.
rows.anchor: على أن فعله جزاء على ما عمله هو من مخالفة أمر الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Be patient” commands servanthood, while “your patience is only through God” discloses divine lordship.
rows.anchor: تكليف ، ( وما صبرك إلا بالله ) : تعريف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet should contemplate God’s decree and not grieve over enemies whom God regards as insignificant.
rows.anchor: أي طالع التقدير ، فما لا نجعل له خطرا عندنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Knowing God alone brings things into being should quiet the heart: God guarantees the Prophet’s sufficiency and bars his enemies from prevailing over him.
rows.anchor: وإذا عرفت انفرادنا بالإيجاد فلا يضيق قلبك بشدة عداوتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Godfearing are those who see support as coming from beyond themselves and disown their own power and strength.
rows.anchor: رؤية النصرة من غيره ، والذين هم أصحاب التبري

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The person of excellence worships God as though seeing Him; this is the state of direct witnessing.
rows.anchor: والمحسن الذي يعبد الله كأنه يراه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses and Aaron’s admission of fear drew from God the assurance “I am with you”; their aim was to hear this promise, since prophecy should remove fear.
rows.anchor: وكان المقصود لهما أن يقول الحق لهما : { إننى معكما }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s assurance calmed both men and enabled them to go to Pharaoh, since effective obligation requires that they be empowered.
rows.anchor: سكن فيهما الخوف بقوله : { إننى معكما }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Israel’s suffering under Pharaoh lasted a long time, but God eventually rescued them; His pattern is to give an oppressor rein before seizing him painfully.
rows.anchor: طال البلاء ببني إسرائيل من جهة فرعون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A messenger must be enabled with a clear sign that demonstrates the truth of his prophetic claim.
rows.anchor: من شرط التكليف التمكين بالبينة والآية للرسول حتى يتضح ما يدل على صدقه فيما يدعو إليه من النبوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The signs did not benefit their audience; they only strengthened the proof against them, since proof cannot help a heart whose inward sight is blind.
rows.anchor: إذا عمي بصر القلب فأنى تنفع بصيرة الحجة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A poet compares a thirsty person seeing water but being barred from reaching it to people unmoved by proof.
rows.anchor: إذا كان ممنوعا سبيل الموارد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Only a heart illuminated by gnosis follows guidance; one covered by ignorance cannot hear it.
rows.anchor: إنما يتبع الهدى من كحل قلبه بنور العرفان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Every prophet warns his people of punishment for abandoning God’s command and promises reward for keeping it.
rows.anchor: ما بعث الله نبيا إلا وقد أنذر قومه بالعذاب على ترك الأمر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The details of deferred punishment and deferred reward remain unknown to those awaiting them.
rows.anchor: فمؤجله لا يوقف على تفصيله الأعداء وكذلك مؤجل الثواب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Immediate punishments take many forms and are directed according to a person’s station; the kind and degree of punishment reflect what is due.
rows.anchor: وأما معجل العقوبة فأنواع ، وعلى حسبت مقام المرء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hardness of heart, obstruction in obedience, and losses of wealth or life are forms of immediate punishment.
rows.anchor: وقسوة القلب نوع عقوبة ، وما يتداخل الطاعة نوع عقوبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question addresses both Moses and Aaron, then singles out Moses by name; the change may match the verse endings.
rows.anchor: { فمن ربكما } على التثنية ، ثم قال : { يا موسى }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, Moses is named because he held precedence over Aaron.
rows.anchor: ويحتمل أن موسى كان مقدما على هارون فخصه بالنداء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses answers by pointing to God’s acts—giving each thing its created form and guidance—as evidence for God’s existence.
rows.anchor: ليعلم أن الدليل على إثباته - سبحانه - ما دلت عليه أفعاله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh claimed the parted sea proved his majesty and divinity, then entered with his army; when the last had entered and the first hoped to escape, the waves drowned them all.
rows.anchor: فقال : ( إنه بحشمتي انفلق ، فأنا ربكم الأعلى ! )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh’s confession came only after despair and could not help him because he persisted until the decree of damnation overtook him.
rows.anchor: وآمن فرعون لما ظهر له اليأس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God recalls His blessings to Israel and commands obedience and gratitude, including for the manna, quail, and trials given to their ancestors.
rows.anchor: ويأمرهم بالتزام الطاعة والقيام بالشكر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Good” sustenance means what is lawful.
rows.anchor: الطيب ما كان حلالا

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: “Good” sustenance means provision acquired without disobeying God.
rows.anchor: ويقال الطيب من الرزق ما لا يعصي الله مكتسبه

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: “Good” sustenance means provision received while consciously witnessing the Sustainer.
rows.anchor: ويقال الطيب من الرزق ما يكون على مشاهدة الرزاق

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: “Good” sustenance means provision that gives rise to gratitude.
rows.anchor: ويقال الطيب من الرزق ما حصل منه الشكر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s elect receive in this life, privately, an early share of the good that others receive openly in the afterlife.
rows.anchor: مؤجل في عقباهم جهرا ، معجل لأصفيائه في دنياهم سرا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Provision differs by level: the self receives enabling, the heart receives affirmation, and the spirit receives realization.
rows.anchor: فرزق النفوس التوفيق ، ورزق القلوب التصديق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One meaning of transgressing in provision is crossing from lawful food into unlawful food.
rows.anchor: بمجاوزة الحلال إلى الحرام

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Another meaning is taking more than the bare minimum needed to survive.
rows.anchor: بالزيادة على الكفاف وما لا بد منه مما زاد على سد الرمق

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Another meaning is eating heedlessly and forgetfully.
rows.anchor: بالأكل على الغفلة والنسيان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s anger may descend through abandonment after one sin follows another.
rows.anchor: فيحل عليكم غضبي بالخذلان لمتابعة الزلة بعد الزلة

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Another explanation is that divine anger comes when people fail to regret what they have lost.
rows.anchor: ويقال فيحل عليكم غضي لفقدكم التأسف على ما فاتكم

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Another explanation is that divine anger comes from accepting one’s diminished spiritual state.
rows.anchor: ويقال بالرضا بما أنتم فيه من نقصان الحال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “All-forgiving” means that a person repents of one slip while God forgives many sins, including hidden sins unknown even to angels.
rows.anchor: منك التوبة عن زلة واحدة ومنه المغفرة لذنوب كثيرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God forgives the person whose heart turns toward Him seeking good and blessing; a poem illustrates love that persists despite harsh treatment.
rows.anchor: وهو يغفر لمن قلبك مريد له بالخير والنعمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The source describes God as forgiving someone who has done the same sort of act as the listener.
rows.anchor: وهو يغفر لمن عمل مثل عملك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A cited poem expresses seeking access through the beloved and everything connected to her, despite her harshness.
rows.anchor: فبربها . . . وبكل متصل بها متوسل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Repentance is valid only for a believer.
rows.anchor: فلا تصح التوبة إلا لمن يكون مؤمنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Faith in this promise includes faith at the end, as well as faith in the present.
rows.anchor: أي آمن في المآل كما هو مؤمن في الحال

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Another reading says the believer knows salvation comes through God’s mercy, not through personal repentance, faith, or obedience.
rows.anchor: ويقال آمن بأنه ليست نجاته بتوبته وبإيمانه وطاعته ، إنما نجاته برحمته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Repentance is from a slip; faith means neither claiming one’s deeds as one’s own nor denying that every event comes from God.
rows.anchor: فلم ير أعماله من نفسه ، وآمن بأن جميع الحوادث من الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Acting righteously means not neglecting the obligatory duties.
rows.anchor: فلم يخل بالفرائض ثم اهتدى للسنة والجماعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being guided means following the Sunna and the community.
rows.anchor: ثم اهتدى للسنة والجماعة

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: “Then” can mark a later stage: faith now, followed by guidance in the outcome.
rows.anchor: ويقال { ثم } : للتراخي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hearing God say “Indeed I” should leave the servant unable to assert an independent “I.”
rows.anchor: ويقال من سمع منه { وإني } لا يقول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sound of “Indeed I am all-forgiving” can overwhelm the hearer with nearness until the hearer is erased and no longer attends to others’ sins.
rows.anchor: استهلك في استيلاء ما غلب عليه من ضياء القربة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One repentance can be met with forgiveness of every kind of sin, public or hidden, small or great, remembered or forgotten.
rows.anchor: كثير المغفرة لمن تاب مرة ؛ فيغفر له أنواعا من ذنوبه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A person should not boast of having done a righteous deed, but regard the deed as small and the state as unstable.
rows.anchor: بل يلاحظ عمله بعين الاستصغار ، وحالته بغير الاستقرار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Then he was guided” means he was guided to God through God.
rows.anchor: ثم اهتدى } : أي اهتدى إلينا بنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses took the people with him but walked ahead; he was corrected to respect the companions’ right.
rows.anchor: فقيل له في ذلك مراعاة لحق صحبتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some people are reproached for arriving late and others for moving ahead; the difference between the two cases is immense.
rows.anchor: ويقال قوم يعاتبون لتأخرهم وآخرون لتقدمهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses hurried from longing for God; the Real drew this explanation from him, for Moses would not have uttered it without that prompting.
rows.anchor: أي عجلت إليك شوقا إليك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses explains that he did not abandon the people through neglect; he hurried only in seeking God’s pleasure.
rows.anchor: أي ما خلفتهم لتضييعي أيامي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s pleasure lay in Moses staying with the people he had brought, especially the weak; being with them mattered more than getting ahead.
rows.anchor: يا موسى إن رضائي في أن تكون معهم وألا تسبقهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God says He tested Moses’ people after him, causing them to stray and worship the calf; this was by divine decree and refutes deniers of predestination.
rows.anchor: فتنا قومك فضلوا وعبدوا العجل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although Moses sought God’s pleasure, God decreed the people’s trial; the ruling belongs to God, and Moses must accept His decree without objection.
rows.anchor: ثم الحكم لله ، ولم يكن بد لموسى عليه السلام من الرضاء بقضاء الله
